user.title: Configure SIM7600
user.description: Select the AT serial port of your SIM7600 module. The port must answer the AT command with OK.

manual.title: Enter serial port
manual.description: Enter the path of the AT serial port, for example /dev/serial/by-id/usb-SimTech-if02-port0 or COM5.

discovery_confirm.title: Configure SIM7600
discovery_confirm.description: SIM7600 module detected on {port}. Configure polling intervals.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the SIM7600 module or it did not answer AT with OK.

abort.not_at_port: This serial interface is not the AT command port.

init.title: SIM7600 Options
init.description: Adjust polling, the default SMS recipient for the notify entity and the optional balance USSD request.

data_description.default_recipient: Phone number used by notify.send_message, e.g. +79991234567. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.balance_ussd: For example *100#. Leave empty to disable the balance sensor.

error.invalid_number: Invalid phone number. Use digits with an optional leading +.
error.invalid_ussd: Invalid USSD code. Use digits, * and #.

send_sms.name: Send SMS
send_sms.description: Sends an SMS via the SIM7600 modem. Non-Latin text (e.g. Cyrillic) is sent as UCS2, long text as a multipart SMS.

number.name: Number
number.description: Recipient phone number: 3-20 digits with an optional leading +.

entry_id.name: Modem
entry_id.description: Config entry of the modem to use. Optional with a single modem.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device of the modem to use. Optional with a single modem.

send_ussd.name: Send USSD
send_ussd.description: Sends a USSD request (e.g. *100#) and returns the network reply.

code.name: Code
code.description: USSD code made of digits, * and #.

entry_id.name: Modem
entry_id.description: Config entry of the modem to use. Optional with a single modem.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device of the modem to use. Optional with a single modem.

modem_not_found.message: The selected SIM7600 modem is not loaded.

multiple_modems.message: Several SIM7600 modems are loaded. Select one with entry_id or device_id.

no_default_recipient.message: No default SMS recipient is configured in the SIM7600 options.

sim_pin_required.title: SIM card is locked
sim_pin_required.description: The SIM card in the modem on {port} reports "{status}". Remove the PIN lock (for example in a phone) and reload the integration.

no_network_registration.title: Modem is not registered in a network
no_network_registration.description: The modem on {port} has not been registered in a mobile network for {minutes} minutes. Check the SIM card, antenna and coverage.
